name: glucoerucin to H
summary: A 4-step route from glucoerucin(1−) to H(+), ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

relations.note: Shares glucoraphanin with H to H2O.
Shares coclaurine with S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine to Luteolin glucoside.
